tool.name: task-stop
tool.description:
Stops (cancels) a running background task started with runInBackground=true.
**Parameters**: - `taskId`: the id from the `[BACKGROUND_TASK started taskId=...]` confirmation.
**Semantics**: - Cancels the task: the sandboxed process is killed via the progress-tracker channel when available, otherwise the fork future is cancelled. - Idempotent: stopping an already-finished task reports its terminal status without state change. - An unknown taskId returns an explicit error. Tasks from another session are refused. - Not subject to activeTags filtering (meta tool).
